# BO-PHP version generates an exception when saving Image settings

After editing some Image settings,when you try to save there is an exception displayed in the BO and it seems related to PHP version since the problem is not reproduced in all PHP versions:

**- PHP v 8.0 & 8.1 & 8.2** :x:

See attached scereenrecord :

https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/92626242/c451bce8-9d38-456d-af88-62b05bf780f8

![image](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/92626242/d14d3947-e988-4950-9dc4-4b1d5547389c)

**- PHP v 7.4** :heavy_check_mark: 

See attached screenrecord:


https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/92626242/42eaa5c9-4502-4efa-bcf9-0e1929b52d90

## Attendu
The exception should not be displayed when Saving the image settings

## Étapes
1. Make sure you are using in your shop BO php version  8.1
2. Design > Image Settings >  Images generation options section
3. Image format : select Use JPEG
4. Click Save button
5. See Error

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
